Woman Found Dead After Reporting Harassment on Train

Himashri Boro, a 20-year-old woman, was found dead on railway tracks the day after she called her mother to report being surrounded by intoxicated individuals and feeling unsafe on a train. Her last known communication indicated she was with a group of drunk men.
